# milestone 4: verification slice backlog

## purpose

The trackable **`M4-S-###`** slice backlog for milestone 4 (advanced verification).
The **definition of done**, scope decisions, macro phases (P0–P4), and completion
criteria live in the hub **`task/sv0-toolchain-milestone-4-verification.Rmd`**; the
per-epic engineering notes live in the owning sub-tasks (`task/sv0c-*.Rmd`). This
file is a **living index** — flip status as slices land and keep it aligned with
the hub's phase narrative.

## how to use

- Pick the next slice by macro phase (hub P0→P4); slices within a phase are roughly
  ordered by dependency.
- Each slice names its **owning sub-task**, an **acceptance** signal, and its
  **phase**. Add a one-line result + commit when a slice lands (like the M3 checklist).
- Keep the spec (`sv0doc`) aligned before claiming new `sv0 verify` behavior (Epic F).

### Epic A — VC generation (`task/sv0c-contract-vcgen.Rmd`)

| ID | slice | phase | status | acceptance |
|----|-------|-------|--------|-----------|
| M4-S-001 | contract-expression IR (flat arena; vars, literals, comparisons, `&&`/`||`/`!`, `+ - * / %`, `old`, `result`) | P0 | **done** | `lib/verify_vcgen.sv0` — arena builders + evaluator + 6 unit tests; gated (stage0 golden + self-host loop 99). `forall`/`exists` deferred to a later slice. |
| M4-S-002 | extract parsed contract clauses (requires/ensures/loop_invariant) into the IR | P0 | **done** | `extract_cexpr` in `lib/verify_vcgen.sv0` translates the body-expr arena (parser output: lit/path/unop/binop/call) → CExpr; `result`→CResult, `old(e)`→COld via the arg sidecar, vars interned into `var_names`; unsupported forms (qualified paths, string/unit lits, bitwise/shift, forall/exists, other calls) → -1 (residual, soundness). 4 extraction tests (compare, result+arith, old, unsupported) on hand-built arenas matching the parser encoding; gate green. |
| M4-S-003 | VC generator — straight-line body (assume `requires`, assert `ensures` at return) | P0/P1 | **done** | `vc_gen_ensures_query` in `lib/verify_vcgen.sv0`: obligation for an ensures = `requires… ∧ (result==return_expr) ⟹ ensures` (requires assumed — caller's obligation). Tested on `f(x) requires(x>0) ensures(result>=1){return x;}` → the exact query z3 proves **unsat** (+ negative: no requires → **sat**/residual). |
| M4-S-004 | VC generator — branches (if/else path conditions) | P1 | **done** | `vc_collect_paths` models `result` as a disjunction over branch paths: `⋁ path (guard ∧ result == returned-value)`, guards accumulating the if-conditions (negated on the else side; fall-through after an always-returning `if` continues under `¬cond`). One query per ensures (`assert requires`, `assert <path-disjunction>`, `assert (not ensures)`, `check-sat`) — verified iff `unsat` on every path. Generalizes the straight-line case (single path) and replaces the ad-hoc result binding + the blanket control-flow guard; loops/match/assignment still → RESIDUAL. Handles if/else (both return), if-without-else fall-through, else-if chains, and if-as-tail. Unit test `test_vc_paths_ifelse` (exact query, no z3) + corpus `branches.sv0` (myabs/clamp_low verified, sign_pos refuted). verify_vcgen 15 tests; corpus 19 contracts / 4 files. |
| M4-S-005 | VC generator — loops via `loop_invariant` (entry ∧ preservation ∧ exit) | P1 | **done** | `loop_invariant(I)` on a `while C { body }` is verified iff it holds on entry AND is preserved by one iteration, packed into one query: `unsat( (entry-hyps ∧ ¬I) ∨ (⋀siblings ∧ C ∧ ¬I') )`. `I'` = `I` with each body-assigned var replaced by its new value (`vc_subst`); the body's straight-line assignments (`v = e` / `v op= e`) are modelled as a sequential substitution transition (re-assignment / control-flow / calls → RESIDUAL). Entry hyps = fn `requires` + pre-loop `let v = e` bindings; sibling invariants are assumed together for each preservation. **Prerequisite parser change:** `parse_while_expr` now records invariant clause ROOTS via a pp sidecar in the while node's `d3` (was the unused `inv_first`; `d4`=count) so they're retrievable — no downstream consumer read `d3`/`d4`. New emission path `verify_fn_loops` walks the body for top-level `while`s. `test_vc_subst` (deterministic) + corpus `loops.sv0` (count_up + accumulate[i≥0 ∧ s≥0 conjunction] verified; entry_fails + preservation_fails runtime). verify_vcgen 16 tests; corpus 26 contracts / 5 files; goldens: parser.c + verify_vcgen.c + vm-parity parser.sv0b refreshed. Nested loops + invariant→ensures "exit/use" wiring deferred. |
| M4-S-006 | `old(expr)` snapshot + `result` binding in VCs | P1 | **done** | `ensures(result == old(x) + 1)` / `ensures(result > old(x))` verify end-to-end. `result` binds to the straight-line return value (M4-S-003); `old(e)` denotes the pre-state — in the straight-line fragment parameters are immutable, so `old(x) == x` and it soundly renders as the current SMT var (distinct pre-state snapshot variables become observable only under mutation/loops, M4-S-004/005). **Soundness guard added** (`vc_body_has_effect`): a body containing reassignment (ExprAssign/AssignOp) or control flow (if/match/while/for/loop) is NOT straight-line — result-binding + `old(x)==x` would be invalid — so every ensures there is kept RESIDUAL. Fixes a real hole found in testing (`fn mutate(mut x){ x = x+1; return x } ensures(result==old(x))` was falsely [verified] → now [runtime]). Unit test `test_body_effect_guard` (14 verify_vcgen tests); corpus `oldstate.sv0` (bump/grow verified, mutate residual). |

### Epic C — `sv0 verify` + contract-mode (`task/sv0c-verify-cli.Rmd`)

| ID | slice | phase | status | acceptance |

| M4-S-020 | `sv0 verify` command (check → VCgen → solver → report) | P0/P1 | **done** | `./scripts/sv0 verify <file>` runs end-to-end. `verify_all_fns` (`lib/verify_vcgen.sv0`) walks the parser's item + body-expr arenas, classifies each contract clause's kind (back-scan from the expression's leftmost-leaf token to the nearest 83/61/73 keyword — parser stores the clause expr but not its keyword), extracts requires (assumed) + ensures (goal) + the straight-line return value via `extract_cexpr`, and emits one `VC\t<fn>\t<line>\t<smt2\|RESIDUAL>` record per ensures. Isolated native build (`scripts/build-sv0-megatu-verify-native.sh`: the 18-module pipeline + `verify_vcgen` + a derived verify main, own `/tmp/.sv0_verify_path` control file — shared compiler/VM/self-host gates untouched). `run_verify` in `scripts/sv0` runs each query through `sv0-z3.sh` → `[verified]`/`[runtime]` (unsat⇒verified; sat/unknown/absent/unsupported⇒runtime, sound). Gated: `scripts/verify_sv0_verify_e2e.py` on `test/verify/basic.sv0` (2 verified, 1 sound residual; skips if z3 absent). |
| M4-S-021 | per-contract human report (`[verified]`/`[runtime]` + reason, `sv0doc` §3.2 format) | P1 | **done** | `sv0 verify` now reports **every** contract clause (requires/ensures/loop_invariant) in source order, matching §3.2: `<file>:<line>  <clause>  [verified\|runtime]  -- <reason>` (aligned columns). The verify binary emits `VC\t<line>\t<kind>\t<clause-text>\t<payload>` (clause text = source span keyword→matching `)`, whitespace-collapsed; `vc_match_rparen` + `vc_clause_text`); `run_verify` derives the reason: requires → "input precondition (assumed locally)" (`PRECOND`); ensures → z3 `unsat` "proven" / `sat` "not proven (counterexample)" / other "not proven (solver: …)"; loop_invariant → "loop invariants not yet supported"; unsupported ensures → "outside supported fragment"; no z3 → "no solver". e2e test updated (2 verified, 5 runtime on basic.sv0). |
| M4-S-022 | machine-readable (JSON) output for tooling/CI | P1 | **done** | `sv0 verify --json <file>` emits one object: `{"file","contracts":[{line,kind,clause,status,reason}…],"summary":{verified,runtime}}` (JSON-escaped via `_json_esc`). Reuses the same per-clause data as the §3.2 table (parent-only change — no compiler/golden churn). Unblocks the verify corpus + CI (M4-S-040/042). e2e test parses `--json` with Python `json` and cross-checks statuses + summary against the text report. |
| M4-S-023 | `--contract-mode` flag (runtime / verified / disabled) | P1 | **done** | `lower()` gained a `contract_mode` param: 0 runtime (default — emit all checks), 1 verified (drop proven ensures), 2 disabled (drop all requires+ensures). The native compiler selects it from the control file: `--verified <proof> <src>` ⇒ mode 1 (parsed in `build-sv0-megatu-native.sh`'s CLI patch, which now replaces the committed source+mode block atomically). Default (plain path / `--project`) stays mode 0, so the shared compiler/self-host/corpus behaviour is byte-identical. `./scripts/sv0 emit-verified <file>` drives it. |
| M4-S-024 | verified-mode codegen — strip proven contracts' runtime checks in lowering, keep unproven | P1 | **done** | In verified mode `lower()` skips `Instr::Ensures` whose clause source line is in `proven_lines` (the proof-results set); requires and unproven ensures are kept (soundness). Contract id = the ensures keyword's source line (both the verify pass and lowering compute it identically). `emit-verified` two-pass: (1) run the VC queries through z3, collect the lines that come back `unsat`; (2) recompile with `--verified <proof> <src>` so the proven checks vanish. Verified: a proven `ensures` emits **no** `sv0_ensures`, an unproven one still does, `sv0_requires` always kept, and the stripped C compiles + runs. Gated by `scripts/verify_contract_mode.py` on `contract_mode_demo.sv0` (runtime 2 ensures → verified 1). |
| M4-S-025 | minimal `sv0.toml` `[build] contract-mode` parsing (flag overrides file) | P1 | **done** | `./scripts/sv0 compile [--contract-mode=runtime\|verified\|disabled] <file>` resolves the mode with precedence **flag > `[build] contract-mode` in an sv0.toml beside `<file>` > default `runtime`** (`scripts/sv0_contract_mode.py` reads the one key). runtime = plain compile; verified = `emit-verified` (strip proven ensures); disabled = compile with all contract checks stripped (native `--disabled` control prefix, `contract_mode` 2). Gated `scripts/verify_contract_toml.py` (sv0.toml=verified → 1 ensures; `--contract-mode=runtime` override → 2). |

### Epic D — refinement types + modular (`task/sv0c-refinement-types.Rmd`)

| ID | slice | phase | status | acceptance |
|----|-------|-------|--------|-----------|
| M4-S-030 | `type T = i32 where <expr>` syntax (parser) + spec delta in `sv0doc/type-system/` | P2 | **done** | `parse_type_alias_item` now accepts an optional `where <predicate>` after the base type (predicate parsed into the body-expr arena; root stored in the type-alias item's `id3`, -1 = plain alias). The predicate refers to the refined value as `self` (per spec §2.8). Threaded the body-expr arena into type-alias parsing + the dispatch. Spec `sv0doc/type-system/rules.md` §2.8 updated with the `self` binder + an M4 status note. Gated by corpus `refined.sv0` (the file must parse for `sv0 verify` to run). Checking the predicate at bindings is M4-S-031 (also needs refined-alias→base resolution at binding sites — a pre-existing gap: aliases as param types don't yet type-check). |
| M4-S-031 | refinement checking at assignment/binding (a VC per assignment) | P2 | **done** | `verify_fn_refinements` finds each `let p: T = e` whose `T` is a refined alias (annotation token in LetStmt `d2` → `vc_find_refined_alias` looks up the type-alias item's stored predicate root), and emits the obligation `pred[self := e]` proven from the fn's requires. `extract_refine` substitutes `self` with the init's CExpr during extraction. `[verified]` = binding satisfies the refinement, `[runtime]` = check kept. Reported as kind `refine` (`<var>: <T>`). **The earlier "needs alias-as-type resolution" worry did not apply** — the verify pass is parse-only and does its own name lookup, so no checker change was needed. Corpus `refined_check.sv0` (from_bounded verified from `a>5`; from_unbounded runtime). |
| M4-S-032 | modular verification — caller args proven against callee `requires` (contracts as summaries) | P2 | **done** | `verify_fn_calls` walks each function body for calls (`vc_collect_calls`), resolves the callee item by name (`vc_find_fn_item`), and for each callee `requires` emits an obligation: `caller-requires ⟹ callee-requires[params := call args]`, proven by z3 without re-analyzing the callee body (contracts as summaries). Params are substituted by the call args via `extract_call_req` (a param→arg extractor that never interns callee param names, avoiding alpha-collision with caller vars); non-param references / unsupported forms → RESIDUAL. Reported as kind `call`: `<file>:<callLine>  <callee> requires(...)  [verified\|runtime]`. Needed `id5` (param-name base) + `fpn` (param name toks) threaded into `verify_all_fns` (+ the verify build patch). Corpus `modular.sv0` (good_caller's call verified from `y>5`, bad_caller's not). |
| M4-S-033 | trait-contract contravariance (`sv0doc` §5) — impl must satisfy/strengthen trait contracts | P2 | **done** | `verify_trait_contracts` emits two `override` obligations per impl-method-that-overrides-a-trait-method: `trait_requires ⟹ impl_requires` (impl WEAKER) and `impl_ensures ⟹ trait_ensures` (impl STRONGER), per LSP (§5.4). Impl↔trait matched by trait name + method name; contracts extracted into a shared arena (params align by name). **Two parser prerequisites built:** (1) `parse_fn_body` now accepts a bodyless `fn sig requires/ensures;` declaration (body_root -1, not lowered) so trait-method contracts are parsed + land in `fcr` — previously any trait with a bodyless method failed to parse; (2) `parse_impl_item` records the impl's trait name token in `id3`. Reported as kind `override` at the impl method's line; `[verified]` = LSP-safe, `[runtime]` = the impl violates contravariance (tested both ways). Corpus `trait_contracts.sv0`. Limitation: trait/impl methods assumed to share parameter names. |
| M4-S-034 | narrowing-cast contracts (`sv0doc` §6) — implicit contract insertion + verification | P2 | **done** | `verify_fn_casts` finds every `v as T` (ExprCast) and, for a narrow integer target (u8/u16/i8/i16 — bounds fit i32), emits the implicit obligation `lo <= v <= hi` for T's range, assuming the fn's `requires`. Provable ⇒ `[verified]` (safe, no runtime check); else `[runtime]` (check kept — soundness). Kind `cast`, clause `as <T>`, at the cast's line. **Parser prerequisite:** the cast target type was parsed into a discarded local type arena, so `parse_cast_expr` now stores the target type NAME TOKEN in the ExprCast `ed3`; `vc_leftmost_leaf_tok` handles tag 20 for the line. Corpus `casts.sv0` (to_u8_safe verified from `x<=200`; to_u8_unsafe runtime). |
